hero_subtitle: Real-CUGAN anime image super-resolution. Everything runs on your own CPU, and your images are never uploaded anywhere.
hero_notice: Processing uses a lot of CPU and roughly 1.6 GB of memory. If the page stops responding, reload and try again.
option_denoise_hint: Pick based on how noisy the source is
option_denoise_conservative_caption: Minimal changes, keeps the original style and texture
option_denoise_none_caption: Sharpens clean images without touching noise
option_denoise_3x_caption: Aggressive cleanup for heavily compressed images
option_preview_hint: How the result is compared to the original
option_preview_overlap_caption: Drag the slider to compare details
option_preview_side_caption: Show both images left and right
option_preview_stack_caption: Show both images one above the other
dropzone_title: Drop an image, or click to choose
dropzone_hint: PNG / JPEG / WebP / BMP. Images stay on this device.
dropzone_invalid: Only PNG / JPEG / WebP / BMP images are supported.
engine_requirements: Requires a modern browser with SIMD and threads (SharedArrayBuffer).
processing_estimating: Estimating the time remaining; progress appears once the first tile is done…
result_compare_hint: Drag the slider to compare the original and the result
error_busy: A job is already running. Please wait.
error_oom: Your browser ran out of memory. Reload the page and try again.
about_lead: Real-CUGAN is a general-purpose anime super-resolution model trained on a million-scale anime dataset, architecturally compatible with Waifu2x.
about_p1: This project compiles ncnn and Real-CUGAN to WebAssembly with Emscripten, so inference runs entirely on the browser's CPU. Nothing is uploaded and no server compute is involved.
about_p2: Because of model size and memory limits, the build bundles the three 2X denoise profiles and the 3X denoise weights.
about_stack_web_value: Vite · React · TanStack Router / Query · Tailwind CSS · shadcn/ui · Paraglide JS
about_stack_deploy_value: Static site, with a Cloudflare Workers config included
about_credits: Model by bilibili/ailab (Real-CUGAN), inference by Tencent/ncnn, toolchain by Emscripten.
footer_note: Built on Real-CUGAN and ncnn, compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten.
footer_privacy: Your images never leave your device.
